name: After § 16
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities for 2025
part_text: 16a. Regrets that certain EU rules and directives, such as the Non-Performing Loans Directive1a and the EU’s fiscal and state aid rules, have played a role in increasing house prices and homelessness across the EU, as they can often prevent Member States from investing comprehensively in tackling the rising costs of housing and rising homelessness; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Directive (EU) 2021/2167of the European Parliament and of the Council of 24 November 2021 on credit servicers and credit purchasers and amending Directives 2008/48/EC and 2014/17/EU (OJ L 438, 8.12.2021, p. 1, ELI: [http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2021/2167/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2021/2167/oj)).
